summary.one_liner: Official Docker image for running Plex Media Server, which streams a user's video, music and photo collections to Plex apps on many devices.
summary.what_it_does: Provides the official Docker container for Plex Media Server, configured through docker run flags or docker-compose templates. It documents three networking modes (bridge, host, and macvlan) with example commands and the port list needed for bridge mode. Environment variables control first-run settings such as hostname, timezone, PLEX_CLAIM token, ADVERTISE_IP, PLEX_UID/PLEX_GID, ALLOWED_NETWORKS, and CHANGE_CONFIG_DIR_OWNERSHIP. Separate volumes hold server config, transcoder temp files, and media. The README also covers the beta and public tags, which download and install the server on startup, plus Intel Quick Sync hardware transcoding via /dev/dri passthrough.
use_cases: run a Plex media server in Docker
stream personal movies and music to devices
set up Plex with host or bridge networking
enable Intel Quick Sync hardware transcoding in a container
migrate an existing Plex config directory into Docker
keep Plex auto-updated via beta or public image tags
how_to_run: docker run -d --name plex --network=host -e TZ=" " -e PLEX_CLAIM=" " -v :/config -v :/transcode -v :/data plexinc/pms-docker
For bridge networking, publish ports 32400/tcp, 8324/tcp, 32469/tcp, 1900/udp, 32410-32414/udp and set ADVERTISE_IP
For macvlan networking, use --network=<macvlan name> with --ip and -h
docker start plex / docker stop plex / docker logs -f plex
notable: Official image maintained by Plex, with beta and public tags that fetch and install the server at container start
Documents bridge, host and macvlan networking with concrete commands and caveats for each
Intel Quick Sync hardware transcoding setup via /dev/dri device passthrough
Warns that the config directory needs file locking, so network shares and Windows SMB mounts can corrupt the database
caveats: Hardware transcoding requires a Plex Pass subscription, per the README
Bridge networking needs manual router port forwarding for remote access
Config on NFS, SMB or Windows-hosted SMB mounts risks database corruption; Windows is marked not recommended
